document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
A hurricane blasts you from the temple of Ithaqua.It continues 
outside, roaring through the arch with a cold fury.

You see your students, holding hats to heads and scrabbling 
for purchase. The winds tear at them with a malignant scream. 
Sylvia is the first to leave the ground, hair whipping around 
her face as she flails. Norman tries to fall prone, but his legs lift 
as his fingers try to grip the earth. Bernard is last, staring into 
your eyes as he levitates. Their figures swirl into the sky like dry 
leaves in a dust devil. The sky darkens and fills with a crushing, 
oppressive presence. A god from Beyond!
